# Meaconing (meaconing.com)

> Beginner-friendly explainer on meaconing: capturing genuine GNSS (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou) signals and re-broadcasting them so receivers compute a false position. Covers GNSS basics, a short overview of every GNSS threat, a deep dive on meaconing (history, forms, why receivers believe it, why it is hard to detect in real time), how crewed aircraft cope versus autonomous drones, and how Ultrakinematic's Navion Terra protects drone operations at any scale up to the MALE segment.

Key facts:
- Meaconing re-sends genuine signals, so cryptographic authentication (Galileo OSNMA) and integrity monitoring (RAIM) report them as valid.
- A relay adds the same delay to every satellite; the receiver absorbs it as its own clock error and reports the attacker's antenna position as a clean fix.
- The term comes from WWII "masking beacons" used by the RAF's No. 80 (Signals) Wing in 1940–41.
- Scale of GNSS attack: ~1,500 flights/day spoofed by August 2024 (OPSGROUP); 970 ships/day jammed in the Gulf, June 2025 (Windward); ~10,000 drones/month lost by Ukraine in 2023, mostly to electronic warfare (RUSI).
- Reliable real-time detection requires comparing GNSS against independent absolute navigation (terrain referencing, scene matching, inertial).

## Guides (one question per page, each also available as Markdown at the same address with a .md ending)

- [What is meaconing?](https://meaconing.com/what-is-meaconing/): Meaconing is capturing genuine GNSS (GPS) signals and re-broadcasting them so a receiver computes the wrong position. What it is, how it works and why every check says the fix is valid.
- [Meaconing vs GPS spoofing](https://meaconing.com/meaconing-vs-spoofing/): Spoofing forges fake GNSS signals; meaconing replays genuine ones. A side-by-side comparison of meaconing, spoofing and jamming, and why meaconing passes authentication checks.
- [The history of meaconing](https://meaconing.com/history-of-meaconing/): Meaconing began in 1940-41 when the RAF's No. 80 (Signals) Wing re-radiated German navigation beacons. How the word came about and how the same trick targets GPS today.
- [Detecting meaconing in real time](https://meaconing.com/detect-meaconing/): Why meaconing is so hard to detect as it happens: an illustrative incident second by second, which GNSS checks work and fail, and the tell-tale signs operators can watch for.
- [Does OSNMA stop meaconing?](https://meaconing.com/osnma-and-meaconing/): OSNMA proves a message came from a real satellite, and a replayed message did. Why signal authentication and RAIM integrity checks do not stop meaconing, and what does.
- [Meaconing and drones](https://meaconing.com/meaconing-and-drones/): Why drones from micro to MALE class are more exposed to meaconing than crewed aircraft, what airliners have that drones lack, and how operators can protect against it.
- [About meaconing.com](https://meaconing.com/about/): Purpose, sources, disclosures and contact
- [Privacy notice](https://meaconing.com/privacy/): No cookies, no analytics or tracking; what is processed and GDPR rights
